title: The first rounds for the academy places
summary: The competition for the Five Great Academies' places begins in front of Mr. Hao, who has come to see what Mu Chen can do. In the first round Mu Chen faces Chen Tong, second only to Liu Mubai in the West Academy, who keeps aiming Flame Heart-Breaking Palm at his face; Mu Chen outpaces him, slaps him, and forces him to concede after his Flame Storm Spiritual Fist. Tang Qian'er and Hong Ling fight to a standstill before Mr. Hao stops the bout without naming a winner, which tells Mu Chen that performance matters more than the result. He tells Mo Ling this before Mo Ling's hopeless fight with Liu Mubai. Mo Ling refuses to give up while Liu Mubai toys with him, until Mr. Hao ends it. Liu Mubai and then Mu Chen volunteer for the single seeded place.
